paper: Lu et al. 2016 CES 143:341-350, pilot DMTO 3D
purpose: Inverse calibration of the unknown distributor hole layout. The paper only gives a 5 % open perforated plate; all explicit paper values stay locked. The result is a calibrated equivalent layout, not the real device.

locked_geometry.opening_ratio_source: paper §2.4 explicit value; the evaluator rescales every candidate to exactly this value
locked_geometry.h_plate_note: coarse-mesh face size at the plate (mesh_stats.json, plenum 3.52 mm)

physics.note: u_hole follows from the 5 % opening and the feed (DEV-3D-004), so it is the same for every candidate

targets.source: Fig.12b C2H4 mass fraction read off the figure (tools/fig12post.py PAPER); Fig.12a 'reaction completes below about 0.2 m'

roles.objective: loss_fig12b = mean(rmse_006, rmse_010): RMSE of the simulated y=0 line divided by its wall value vs the paper points divided by theirs
roles.gates: constraints taken from the paper; the search sees them
roles.sealed_note: Fig.12a plateau height is an independent observation and is never shown to the proposer; it is opened only by `rsi.py final`

thresholds_approval: user approved the drafted thresholds unchanged on 2026-11-04; trials run on 24 cores in parallel with NUM-3D-007
